scope: The 16 named focus templates and their 24 declared instances, n=1..7 exhaustive plus n=8,10,12 fixtures
counting_contract: A template is a parameterized mathematical function; each declared parameter assignment is an instance. Encoding choices never increase mathematical counts.

proved_same_input_equivalences.reason: Both equal n; constant conditional on length

additional_invertible_answer_map_equival.note: Not collapsed in the value-preserving count. Quotienting also by this declared affine map gives 19 classes, 18 nonconstant. Not a complete classification under arbitrary answer maps.

limitations: Counts describe this declared inventory and equivalence policy, not a number of independent information sources.
Known joint formulas and one-way maps do not collapse task templates.
Different task families are not asserted unrelated.
